what_it_is.prose: Northrop Grumman is a major US defence and aerospace prime. Its relevance to the India military-aerospace Atlas is as a component supplier rather than a direct India-footprint entity. Northrop Grumman produces the AN/APN-241 (also known as the Low Power Color Radar, LPCR, or MR-4000), an X-band weather and navigation radar developed specifically for the C-130 Hercules family and fitted to the C-130J Super Hercules; it provides high-resolution ground mapping for low-level navigation and precision airdrop, predictive windshear detection and all-weather situational awareness. Because the Indian Air Force operates 12 Lockheed Martin C-130J-30 Super Hercules, Northrop Grumman equipment is present on those Indian aircraft as embedded OEM-fit content within the US platform. However, a review of public primary sources did not surface any direct Northrop Grumman-India contract, joint venture, offset commitment or India-specific programme. This Tier C compact card therefore records the genuine but indirect C-130J radar link honestly, is marked noindex, and preserves the slug pending any future primary-source evidence of a direct India footprint.
